title: EmbodiedGPT: Vision-Language Pre-Training via Embodied Chain of Thought

layout.note: A single column of speech bubbles runs top to bottom with avatars at the left, human turns in orange and assistant turns in blue; a boxed bar chart sits at the lower right beside the second, narrower pair of bubbles.

lesson: Show a model's capabilities as a short real conversation: tint bubbles by speaker, draw the input video as a framed strip inside the user's bubble, tint the key phrases of the answers, and tuck one small result chart beside the dialogue.
